name: Dreadmaul Rock
summary: In the Burning Steppes, Sha'ni's platoon has been gone for more than three weeks. Thal'trak Proudtusk cannot leave his post, and asks you to learn what became of his wife.

sections.title: A Husband Without Word
sections.body: Sha'ni went to the Burning Steppes to investigate strange rituals among the Firegut ogres. More than three weeks have passed, and Goretooth has heard nothing from her platoon. He tells Thal'trak to put the matter behind him and keep to his duty. But Sha'ni is his wife, and Thal'trak will not accept that. Bound to his post, he asks you to search for her.

sections.title: Sha'ni's Words
sections.body: Sha'ni speaks of Thal'trak with pity. They had planned to live with her mother and father in the Hinterlands once their tours were over. Now those plans are ruined.

faq.answer: Thal'trak is looking for his wife, Sha'ni Proudtusk. She was sent to the Burning Steppes to investigate strange rituals among the Firegut ogres, and no one has heard from her.

faq.q: Why did Sha'ni go to the Burning Steppes?
faq.answer: Sha'ni was sent to the Burning Steppes more than three weeks ago to investigate reports of strange rituals among the Firegut ogres.

faq.q: Why hasn't Thal'trak searched for her himself?
faq.answer: Thal'trak cannot leave his post, so he asks you to search for Sha'ni in his place.

faq.q: What does Goretooth say about the missing platoon?
faq.answer: Goretooth has heard nothing from anyone in Sha'ni's platoon. He advises Thal'trak to put the matter behind him and keep to his duty.
